goal: Dispatch an Agentplane task through a Hermes Kanban worker lane without transferring engineering task truth to Hermes.

task_template.title: Dispatch Agentplane task through Hermes
task_template.description: Create a Hermes Kanban projection for the Agentplane task and supervise it with the Agentplane-owned Hermes adapter.

doc.summary: Use Hermes as the durable dispatch/run substrate and Agentplane as the Git-visible engineering evidence substrate.
doc.scope: Create or operate a Hermes projection for an existing Agentplane task.
doc.plan: Check adapter readiness, render or create the Hermes projection, supervise one route-gated step per claim, and close Hermes only after Agentplane terminal gates.
doc.verify_steps: Confirm doctor output is healthy, supervise output refuses raw shell, enqueue/supervise return hermes_comment_projection with runner visibility commands, Hermes lifecycle comments point to Agentplane evidence, and terminal completion requires DONE plus verification ok plus ACR validation.
doc.rollback_plan: Archive or block stale Hermes projections; do not rewrite Agentplane task truth based on Hermes state.

task_id.description: Agentplane task id to project into Hermes.

hermes_assignee.description: Hermes worker lane assignee, such as agentplane-coder.

hermes_card_projection.description: Provider-safe card body and metadata from `agentplane hermes enqueue`.

verification_evidence.description: Verification checks recorded in Agentplane and projected to Hermes comments.

acr_path.description: Path to the validated Agent Change Record.

steps.summary: Run `agentplane hermes doctor --json` and verify branch_pr, binaries, lane registry, and Hermes environment readiness.
Render or create the Hermes card projection with `agentplane hermes enqueue <task-id> --json`.
Run `agentplane hermes supervise <task-id> --execute-step --json` for one allowlisted route step.
Post the `hermes_comment_projection` packet before block or complete using `agentplane hermes lifecycle comment`.
Complete Hermes only after Agentplane DONE, verification ok, branch_pr finish, and local ACR validation.
